provenance: FAN-3093 (rework of FAN-2620): dedicated 8-direction pack replacing the single west-facing flip-mirrored pack. scale/position recomputed for the new 245px-visible-height/32px-bottom-padding normalization (old pack's own bbox pinned bottom at a different offset) so the feet land on the same footline as before: 0.70/-82.0 -> 0.59/-78.0, solving for the same ~54.5px feet-below-origin offset the old pack used.
